public_holidays: 2027-10-05 (Tuesday): Criação do Estado de Roraima (data magna), state holiday set by the state constitution (art. 9)
culture-cycles.note: The state sets other optional days (pontos facultativos, such as Carnival) by a yearly decree for its own offices; the 2027 decree is not yet published. Municipal holidays are not covered here.

sources.title: Constituição do Estado de Roraima, art. 9
sources.supports: 5 October as a holiday across the state; read 2026-11-06
